fm-brand.usage: Marks and highlights only; never a button fill.

title.purpose: Card and panel headings, the wordmark.

shadows.name: fm-shadow
shadows.purpose: Cards on the page background. Never nested.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Colour-only hover and active feedback; removed under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main deliberate action on a screen: a dark ink pill.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--fm-ink); color: #fff; font: 600 13px/1.2 Inter, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #000; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--fm-ink); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A secondary action: white pill with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid var(--fm-line); border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; color: var(--fm-ink2); font: 500 13px/1.2 Inter, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms ease-out, color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--fm-ink); color: var(--fm-ink); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--fm-ink); }

components.name: Card
components.description: A task region lifted off the page with the one soft shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 24px; border-radius: 14px; background: #fff; color: var(--fm-ink); box-shadow: var(--fm-shadow), inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6); }

components.name: Governance Input
components.description: A labelled field for filters and review metadata.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--fm-ink2); font: 500 12.5px/1.2 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid var(--fm-line); border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: var(--fm-ink); font: 400 13px/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--fm-ink); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--fm-ink); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: A non-color-only control or evidence state.
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--fm-bg); color: var(--fm-ink2); font: 600 11.5px/1.2 Inter, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Control Trace Row
components.description: The scan line for control, evidence, and finding traceability.
components.css: .ds-control-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 90px minmax(220px,1fr) 130px 100px; gap: 12px; align-items: center; min-height: 52px; padding: 10px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--fm-line); color: var(--fm-ink); font: 400 13px/1.4 Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-control-row:hover { background: var(--fm-bg); } .ds-control-row:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--fm-ink); outline-offset: -2px; }

narrative.overview: FairMind is a shared technical workbench for engineers, compliance leads, and auditors. It is calm, precise, and trustworthy, and explicit about what is observed, inferred, accepted, failed, or unknown.
keyCharacteristics: White 14px cards with one soft shadow on a warm grey page.
Ink, not black, for text and primary fills.
Rounded-full pill controls; orange is a brand accent only.

rules.name: The Evidence Color Rule
rules.body: Color may reinforce a labelled state, but color alone never carries readiness, severity, freshness, or review meaning.

rules.name: The Accent Rule
rules.body: --fm-brand marks the brand and highlights; it is never a button fill or a page wash.

rules.name: The Scan First Rule
rules.body: A reviewer must identify scope, status, owner, and next action without reading paragraph text.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: Only cards carry --fm-shadow. Everything inside a card is flat and separated by hairlines.

dos: Do use var(--fm-*) tokens and the shared Card, Button, Pill, and FramedIcon primitives.
Do show company, AI system, framework version, and review period before readiness information.
Do use tables and split views inside cards for dense governance work.
donts: Don't reintroduce the retired neobrutalist style.
Don't use gradients, gloss, glassmorphism, neon glow, or press-down transforms.
Don't imply that a score, accepted artifact, or FairMind evaluation automatically proves compliance or certification.
